organizations.publicNote: American manufacturing company. Victor was a record-label imprint and is represented separately from the corporate body.
American record-label imprint. Victor 4381 was manufactured by RCA Manufacturing Company in 1938; the label is represented separately from that corporate body.

sources.researchNote: The record gives the heading RCA Manufacturing Company with the variants R.C.A. Manufacturing Company and Radio Corporation of America. RCA Manufacturing Company. It notes that on 31 December 1942 the company became the RCA Victor Division of its parent, Radio Corporation of America. Consulted as the register's JSON representation.
